# DECHY

> DECHY Tech (DECHY): Technology, Software, AI & Digital Solutions. A global technology company that designs, builds, and supports custom software, websites and web apps, mobile apps, AI and automation, system integrations, cloud and security, data, design, branding, search visibility, digital marketing, and technology consulting. Since 2010, DECHY has helped over 1,200 organizations, companies, firms, brands, businesses, individuals, professionals, teams, and other clients across a wide range of industries and business types.

DECHY works with clients worldwide, online. It has no physical offices. Contact: hello@dechytech.com or https://www.dechytech.com/contact/
